description: LIDER IT Custom Matrix is a Power BI matrix designed for profit and loss statements, balance sheets and other financial reports. Row formatting the standard matrix can’t do • Format whole rows, including the row header: background, font colour, bold, italic, lines and indentation. • Choose rows by their label (with wildcards) or by the value of a model field, such as an indentation level or category. • Optional DAX measure to drive row styles from your model. Values and conditional formatting • Negative and positive colours, sign icons (✓ ✕, ▲ ▼), parentheses for negatives and percentage capping — set per measure. • Colour scales, traffic-light thresholds and data bars, plus a cell-level DAX measure for custom logic. Matrix behaviour • Expand/collapse rows and column groups, subtotals and grand totals, drill-down. • Cross-filtering and drill-through by row and column. • Column auto-fit, fit-to-width, fixed width or drag to resize. • High contrast support and keyboard focus. The visual processes data only within Power BI and does not connect to any external service.
